title: Daily Temperatures
summary: For each day, report how many days must pass before the first strictly warmer day.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100,000 readings, each an integer from 30 to 100. Days are consecutive and zero-based in the input.

statement: For each day, report how many days must pass before the first strictly warmer day. Use zero when there is no later warmer day. Return the answers in the order of the input.

examples.explanation: The first two days wait for 64, and both 64 and 63 wait for 68.
The readings never rise above an earlier reading.
A reading of 46 never has a strictly warmer successor.

constraints: 1–100,000 readings, each an integer from 30 to 100. Days are consecutive and zero-based in the input.
hints: Conceptual: Several earlier days can still be waiting when a warmer reading arrives.
Directional: Keep unresolved day indices in a stack ordered by decreasing or equal temperature.
Implementation: Resolve and pop each cooler day at the top of the stack. The answer is the difference between the current and popped indices.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space excluding output. Each day is pushed and popped at most once.
